heading: Inspect the Stack Inside Real Architecture
intro: Click any technology or engineering pattern below to trace where it runs, why it was chosen over simpler alternatives, and which contract or case study documents it.

items.label: LightGBM 4.6 (LGBMClassifier / LGBMRegressor)
items.whereItRuns: Oracle supervised probability & exit-policy challengers (max_depth=3, num_leaves=8 complexity bounds) inside Trade Bot.
items.whyChosen: Captures non-linear feature interactions while depth constraints and calibrated linear baselines prevent overfitting noisy financial series.

items.label: Scikit-Learn 1.9 (LogisticRegression, StandardScaler, SimpleImputer)
items.whereItRuns: Direction-only and full-feature linear benchmark pipelines inside Oracle cross-validation.
items.whyChosen: Provides calibrated probabilistic baselines; tree challengers must beat linear log-loss and ROC-AUC out-of-sample before promotion.

artifact.label: Case Study 02: Challenger vs. Baseline Suite

items.label: UMAP + HDBSCAN 0.8.33 + SciPy
items.whereItRuns: Wave Y unsupervised regime discovery pipeline over 30+ microstructural and cross-asset features.
items.whyChosen: Projects non-linear state spaces into density clusters with explicit noise separation rather than forcing every bar into arbitrary k-means centroids.

artifact.label: Case Study 02: Wave Y Regime Discovery

items.label: Purged Walk-Forward & Episode-Grouped CV
items.whereItRuns: Expanding quantile split validator enforcing outcomeAvailableAt < fold_start and PURGE_4H_MS embargo.
items.whyChosen: Eliminates forward-window lookahead bias and overlapping episode leakage that invalidate naive time-series k-fold results.

items.label: Feature Ablation & Counterfactual Attribution
items.whereItRuns: Wave Y hl02 feature ablation + Property Intelligence typed facet retrieval ablation benchmarks.
items.whyChosen: Measures marginal signal contribution per feature group so uninformative dimensions are pruned rather than carried into production.

items.label: Tantivy 0.26.2 (Rust BM25)
items.whereItRuns: Lexical top-100 retrieval lane inside hybrid_catalogue_index.py with parser-safe term serialization.
items.whyChosen: Delivers fast in-process BM25 scoring on exact material, SKU, and dimension facets with zero external database dependencies.

items.label: ONNX Runtime 1.31.0 (multilingual-e5-small 384-d)
items.whereItRuns: Sequential CPU dense vector encoder (attention-mask mean pooling + L2 normalization) inside Property Intelligence.
items.whyChosen: Runs quantized/pinned local embeddings deterministically offline, avoiding external API rate limits and cost spikes during Beam Search.

items.label: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60) & Beam Search
items.whereItRuns: Fuses BM25 and ONNX vector candidate rankings before multi-item Beam Search ensemble optimization.
items.whyChosen: Combines lexical exactness and semantic similarity without brittle score-scale calibration, using deterministic 5-key tie-breaking.

items.label: Gemini Vision API + Manhattan Camera Calibration
items.whereItRuns: Photo observation stages paired with deterministic wide-angle normalization and 2D spatial clearance linting.
items.whyChosen: Separates pixel-level room observations from geometric camera math so vision models never hallucinate square footage.

items.label: DuckDB 1.5 (httpfs + spatial)
items.whereItRuns: Remote Overture Maps spatial queries in Property Intelligence and columnar Parquet feature scans in Trade Bot.
items.whyChosen: Executes analytical SQL and geospatial predicates directly over Parquet/Overture files with zero warehouse cluster overhead.

items.label: Apache Arrow / PyArrow 16.1 + Parquet
items.whereItRuns: Multi-gigabyte market archive storage and feature pipeline transport across Oracle and Wave Y.
items.whyChosen: Zero-copy columnar reads paired with SHA-256 digest verification ensure reproducible historical replay.

items.label: PostgreSQL + Redis (ioredis) + SQLite
items.whereItRuns: discovery_dataset_rows, execution lifecycle persistence, and optimizer dispatch queues in Trade Bot.
items.whyChosen: Separates durable transactional trade state (PostgreSQL) from low-latency queue signaling (Redis) and portable local state (SQLite).

items.label: Shapely 2.0 + Overture Maps + Catastro / INE / IGN
items.whereItRuns: Property-centered geospatial buffers, Haversine/IDW metrics, and official Spanish demographic/hazard joins.
items.whyChosen: Grounds location intelligence in official government endpoints and deterministic geometry while flagging NoData cells as UNKNOWN.

items.label: 18-Stage Python DAG Orchestrator (S01-S18)
items.whereItRuns: SingleActionStage and ItemSequenceStage orchestrator with CheckpointManager and StageLogger span tracing.
items.whyChosen: Allows partial resume after transient provider errors without re-executing costly upstream vision or API calls.

items.label: 200 JSON Schema Contracts + AJV + Semantic Validators
items.whereItRuns: Epistemic output guards in Property Intelligence and compiled block logic validation in Trade Bot.
items.whyChosen: Turns model and strategy invariants into deterministic CI gates instead of hoping prose prompts stay compliant.

items.label: TypeScript AST Node-Graph Compiler & 1:1 Replay
items.whereItRuns: Compiles @xyflow/react strategy graphs into runtime blocks verified by proc204/proc206 replay harnesses.
items.whyChosen: Guarantees identical decision logic across backtest, historical replay, paper trading, and live Express 5/CCXT execution.

items.label: L0-L5 Progressive Context Retrieval Gate
items.whereItRuns: Governs which layers of the GÜELGA repository AI personas can load during brand, UI, and QA tickets.
items.whyChosen: Prevents context rot from rejected prototypes and stops generic UI skills from overriding approved brand tokens.

items.label: React 19 + NPM Workspaces Monorepo (@guelga/*)
items.whereItRuns: 6 shared design-system packages powering Widgetbook (@guelga/docs), apps/web, and Journey State prototype.
items.whyChosen: Enforces strict separation between pure token/component libraries and decoupled view-model presentation surfaces.

items.label: @xyflow/react (React Flow v12) + Dagre + Lightweight Charts
items.whereItRuns: Visual strategy cockpit in Trade Bot with Zustand state and automated DAG node layout.
items.whyChosen: Lets researchers compose complex conditional block graphs visually while enforcing strict JSON Schema compilation.

items.label: Layered SVG 2D Floorplan Projection & React 19 UI
items.whereItRuns: Python SVG plan composer feeding an isolated React 19 + Vite + Tailwind CSS v4 presentation bundle.
items.whyChosen: Keeps geometry deterministic on the Python side and turns the browser app into a pure zero-inference renderer.

items.label: Playwright (CDP & Headless) + Axe-core (WCAG)
items.whereItRuns: Release QA verifier in GÜELGA (multi-viewport renders, WCAG checks, SHA-256 font/SVG checks) and CDP acquisition in PI.
items.whyChosen: Catches contrast regressions, layout breakage, and accidental vector mutations automatically before release.
